key_idea: Find the cookie that runs out first: the stars.
steps: One tray has 3 stars and 2 hearts. The plate has 10 stars and 5 hearts.
Stars: 3 trays give 3 + 3 + 3 = 9 stars. That is 1 too few. 4 trays give 12 stars, which is enough.
Hearts: 4 trays give 8 hearts. The plate needs only 5.
So the smallest number of trays is 4.

choice_feedback.A: 1 tray has only 3 stars, but the plate has 10.
choice_feedback.B: 2 trays have only 6 stars, but the plate has 10.
choice_feedback.C: 3 trays have only 9 stars, but the plate has 10.
choice_feedback.E: 4 trays are already enough, so 5 is not the smallest.
